title: NPD UX Audit
subtitle: Automated UX audits grading the NPD prototype against the shipped build, organized by customer journey.
note: Public mirror. Findings only; standards are linked, not reproduced. Personas are illustrative, AI-generated likenesses.

pass.label: Pass
pass.def: Meets the standard, or the difference between prototype and build is acceptable. No action needed.

fail.label: Fail
fail.def: Measured against a documented standard and falls short (accessibility, a violated pattern, a broken flow). Needs remediation; fix in build or mockup.

review.label: Review
review.def: The prototype and build differ, but no standard yet says they must align. A design decision, not a defect.

pending.label: Pending
pending.def: This lens has not been run for this journey yet.

journeys.name: Verify a provider
journeys.blurb: A Medicare beneficiary searches for a provider and opens the detail page to confirm the provider is legitimate.

A1.why: The build is missing avatars, shows attestation as a pill, and uses a multi-color badge set; the prototype matches the standard.

A23.why: Muted badge contrast passes WCAG AA and prototype avatars carry alt text.

A6.why: The build's multi-color status badges violate pill standard v1.2 (binary green-check / gray-x); the verified green is off-token.

A7.why: The build shows ALL-CAPS names with inconsistent order. One secondary item is a mockup fix: the prototype's title-case provider-type toggle label should be sentence case.

journeys.name: Own and attest my record
journeys.blurb: A practitioner claims their own record and attests that the information is correct.

journeys.name: Administer the organization
journeys.blurb: An authorizing official manages an organization's record, locations, and staff.

journeys.name: Delegate / act on behalf
journeys.blurb: An access manager delegates permissions so a surrogate can act on behalf of a provider or organization.

journeys.name: Consume the data
journeys.blurb: A researcher queries and exports directory data through the public interface and API.
